description: Check a message against the connected site's spam rules and, when configured, its intent classifier. Returns the screening decision and reason. This preview does not store the message, send it to a customer, or process a payment.

formType.description: Optional form-type preset to evaluate against.

message.description: Inbound form message or inquiry text to evaluate.

site.description: A site connected to your LeadShield account, such as 'review-demo'.

name: leadshield_screen_submission
title: Screen a contact form message
